Pan context and uncertainty — P4

The reconstructed pan is a visual context for design exploration. It must not be used to manufacture a replacement pan or infer a measured Solstice fit.

FeatureValue / constructionEvidence class
GM12601240 overall envelope474.7 mm long × 316 mm maximum width × 117.99 mm depthPublished GM product specification; overall only
Deep and shallow sump relationshipDeep region beneath removable cover, shallower ribbed extension; tube toward deep-end flangeOEM source-photo topology; no metric calibration
Cast outline and internal wall thicknessPolygonal approximation; inner outline scaled .90 in X and .95 in YDesign assumption; not measured wall thickness
Floor and shallow shelfZ=4 floor; Z=74 shallow shelfDesign assumption; not an actual cavity section
Reference coverAsymmetric relief plate, Z=70 underside, 1 mm visual plateDesign assumption; no stock/height specification
Raised cover reliefHalf-cylinder visual cueTopology inspired by photo; radius/position unknown
Pickup test keep-outØ60 × 10 mm cylinder centred (0,112,18)Explicit design test case; actual screen outline/clearance unknown
Tube test envelopeØ18 mm piecewise route through the concept's reliefExplicit design assumption; actual tube centreline and flex unknown
Insert placementRotate 180°; translate (0,112,7) mmIllustration transform; not measured installed registration
Lower wall-to-floor gap3 mm in the proxyIllustration only; no flow/retention or operating-clearance acceptance
Vehicle mountingNo positioned tabs, bosses, bolts or mount holes in new conceptsUnresolved; omission must remain visible in fit claims

Reference: official GM pan interior, official product. The retained exact-interface follow-up identifies the pan/cover/baffle screw family but supplies no metric hidden cavity or five-seat coordinates.

Full-pan cutaway images remove part of one side wall to expose the insert. Detail views additionally crop the shallow extension. Section models remove one half through X=0; this can hide side gates and is not an instruction to remove parts. Exploded views move the insert and cover vertically for explanation, without modelling a proven removal path or mounting connection.

All render views use the same source placement. Grey is the assumed pan/cover context; purple is the assumed pickup/tube test envelope; blue/teal is custom structure and gold is the custom moving leaf. Real source photography remains separate from rendered concept geometry.
